task_definition.task_description: Please check the status of my investment account, get the USD-to-EUR exchange rate, and then prepare a high-priority email with a cross-currency balance and market snapshot for me. After that, check whether NASDAQ is open, get the current AAPL price, use that quote to sell 10 shares of AAPL, and then email me a high-priority trade execution summary. Finally, retrieve my investment balance sheet and publish it to me by email.

user_input.query: Hi, for user_01, please check the status of my investment account and get the USD-to-EUR exchange rate. Then prepare and send me a high priority email with my cross-currency balance in EUR and a market snapshot. After that, please check whether NASDAQ is open, get the current AAPL price, and use that quote to sell 10 shares of AAPL. Once the trade is done, send me a high priority email with the trade execution summary. Finally, retrieve my investment balance sheet and publish it to me by email.
